WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A single anime entry in a user's personal watchlist.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this item.

id.description: The AniList ID of the anime.

status.description: Current tracking status in the archive.

lastNotifiedEpisode.description: The last episode number for which a notification was generated to prevent repeats.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: A broadcast alert for the user regarding their watchlist activity.

/watchlists/{animeId}.description: User watchlist collection where each document is keyed by the anime's ID.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: User notifications for airing updates and news.
